title: How much of the forest sink is passive? Case of the United States
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
Over time, carbon sequestered in temperate forests has increased, but the relative effects of passive and active drivers remain unclear. This study uses plot-level data to disentangle the contributions of six drivers (temperature, precipitation, CO
2
, management, age composition, and area) to these increases in 14 forest groups of the conterminous United States. From 2005 to 2022, the passive drivers (CO
2
, temperature, and precipitation) increased live tree carbon (C) by 66 teragrams (Tg) C y
−1
with CO
2
fertilization contributing most of the change. Among the anthropogenic drivers, declining forest area reduced live tree C by 31 Tg C y
−1
while tree planting increased it by 23 Tg C y
−1
. Changes in age composition, driven by both passive traits and anthropogenic choices, increased live tree C by 89 Tg C y
−1
. By quantifying the share of removals attributable to passive uptake, this approach enables nations with national forest inventories to better utilize their forests to meet net-zero requirements.
abstract_zh: 随着时间推移，温带森林固存的碳有所增加，但被动驱动因素与主动驱动因素各自的相对作用仍不清楚。本研究利用样地层面的数据，分解了六种驱动因素（温度、降水、二氧化碳、经营管理、林龄结构和面积）对美国本土14个森林类群碳增加的贡献。2005至2022年间，被动驱动因素（二氧化碳、温度和降水）使活立木碳增加了每年66太克（Tg）碳，其中二氧化碳施肥效应贡献最大。在人为驱动因素中，森林面积减少使活立木碳每年减少31 Tg碳，而植树造林使其增加每年23 Tg碳。林龄结构的变化，既受被动特征影响，也受人为选择影响，使活立木碳每年增加89 Tg碳。通过量化可归因于被动吸收的碳汇部分，该方法使拥有国家森林清查体系的国家能够更好地利用其森林，以满足净零排放的要求。

title: Conversions of natural forests to plantations induced by wood pellet expansion
Estimating weather shock impacts on the economic value of forests: The case of a category 5 hurricane
Examining the effectiveness of non-profit groups' expenditures on species recovery: The case of Pacific salmon and steelhead
Prescribed fires as a climate change adaptation tool
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Climate change has been shown to increase wildfire risk, while prescribed burning is a potential management action that landowners can perform to adapt to such climate-driven changes in risk. This study builds off natural resource economic theory to illustrate how wildfire is jointly determined with privately optimal prescribed burn decisions by landowners. We use panel data on prescribed burn permits across the southeastern U.S. states to empirically estimate (i) how climate and previous large wildfire events affect prescribed burn decisions and (ii) how climate and prescribed burning affect the occurrence of large wildfires. Based on an instrumental variables identification strategy, our estimated simultaneous system finds that a hotter and drier climate will increase prescribed burning, with landowner adaptation to corresponding wildfire risk being a key mechanism. By 2050, we find that a hotter and drier future climate will increase the number of large wildfires from 27 per year under current conditions to 36 per year with climate change but no climate adaptation, and 29 large wildfires per year with both climate change and climate adaptation. This paper provides intuition and quantitative evidence regarding the interaction between climate, wildfire, and landowner management adaptation.
abstract_zh: 气候变化已被证明会增加野火风险，而计划烧除（prescribed burning）是土地所有者可以采取的一种潜在管理行动，以适应这种由气候变化驱动的风险变化。本研究以自然资源经济学理论为基础，阐明野火如何与土地所有者在私人最优条件下的计划烧除决策共同决定。我们利用美国东南部各州计划烧除许可的面板数据，实证估计：（i）气候和以往的大型野火事件如何影响计划烧除决策；（ii）气候和计划烧除如何影响大型野火的发生。基于工具变量识别策略，我们估计的联立方程组发现，气温更高、更干燥的气候将增加计划烧除，而土地所有者对相应野火风险的适应是一个关键机制。到2050年，我们发现，在更炎热、更干燥的未来气候下，大型野火数量将从当前条件下的每年27起，增加到气候变化但无气候适应情形下的每年36起，以及气候变化与气候适应并存情形下的每年29起。本文为气候、野火与土地所有者的管理适应之间的相互作用提供了直观理解和定量证据。

title: The impacts of climate-induced insect damage on timberland values in the southeastern US
An econometric analysis of wildfire risk on forest management decisions
Economics of climate change adaptation through land use and management
abstract: This paper synthesizes recent economic research on climate change adaptation through land use and land management decisions. Climate change affects land-based activities by altering productivity, prices, and the frequency of natural disturbances, prompting landowners to adjust management practices to maximize land value. We develop a conceptual framework in which landowners choose management systems to maximize the present value of returns, highlighting how climate influences yields, land quality, prices, and disturbance risks. Adaptation occurs when landowners switch to management systems better suited to changing conditions, subject to transition costs. While the value of adaptation arises from these discrete adjustments, uncertainty about future climate creates the possibility of maladaptation. We review empirical strategies used to identify adaptation, including panel data approaches that distinguish short-run weather responses from long-run adjustments and spatial “space-for-time” substitution. Two applications—tree species replanting and prescribed burning—illustrate how adaptation can reshape landscapes, affect ecosystem services, and mitigate wildfire risk. A central insight is that privately optimal adaptation may diverge from socially optimal outcomes due to spatial externalities and public goods. As a result, adaptation may be under- or over-provided, highlighting the need for policies that better align private incentives with social objectives.
abstract_zh: 本文综合了近期关于通过土地利用和土地管理决策实现气候变化适应的经济学研究。气候变化通过改变生产力、价格以及自然干扰的频率，影响以土地为基础的活动，促使土地所有者调整管理措施，以使土地价值最大化。我们构建了一个概念框架，其中土地所有者选择管理系统，以最大化回报的现值，并突出气候如何影响产量、土地质量、价格和干扰风险。当土地所有者转向更适应变化条件的管理系统时，即发生适应，但这需要承担转换成本。虽然适应的价值源于这些离散的调整，但对未来气候的不确定性也可能带来适应不当（maladaptation）的可能性。我们回顾了用于识别适应的实证策略，包括能够区分短期天气反应与长期调整的面板数据方法，以及空间上的“以空间代时间”（space-for-time）替代。两个应用——树种补植和规定火烧——说明了适应如何重塑景观、影响生态系统服务并缓解野火风险。一个核心启示是，私人最优的适应可能与社会最优结果相背离，原因在于空间外部性和公共物品。因此，适应可能供给不足或过度供给，这凸显了需要制定能够使私人激励与社会目标更好契合的政策。

title: Weather variability risks slow climate adaptation: An empirical analysis of forestry
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The timing of climate adaptation decisions can have substantial consequences for the assessment of climate damages. Since weather variability can create risks for natural resource management that differ across adaptation choices, such variability has the potential to alter the speed of climate adaptation. This paper estimates the effect of weather variability on the timing of adaptation decisions of forest landowners in the Eastern United States. A discrete-choice econometric model of forest management is estimated and used in a bio-economic simulation that shows how variability in cold temperatures can significantly slow the rate of adapting from cold-tolerant natural hardwood forests to cold-sensitive, but highly valuable pine plantations. The range of weather variability in climate projections and across the landscape generates large differences in adaptation timing. Ignoring projected future decreases in weather variability results in a large downward bias in estimating future paths of climate adaptation. Since pine plantations produce fewer non-market ecosystem services than natural hardwood forests, an important source of future conservation uncertainty is the economic response of private forest landowners to changing weather variability.
abstract_zh: 气候适应决策的时机，可能对气候损害的评估产生重大影响。由于天气变异性会给自然资源管理带来随适应选择而异的风险，这种变异性有可能改变气候适应的速度。本文估计了天气变异性对美国东部森林土地所有者适应决策时机的影响。我们估计了一个森林经营的离散选择计量模型，并将其用于生物经济模拟，结果表明，寒冷气温的变异性可能显著减缓从耐寒的天然阔叶林向耐寒性较弱但经济价值很高的松树人工林的转换速度。气候预测和景观范围内天气变异性的区间很大，导致适应时机存在巨大差异。忽视未来天气变异性预计下降的情况，将导致对未来气候适应路径的估计出现较大的向下偏误。由于松树人工林提供的非市场生态系统服务少于天然阔叶林，未来保护的一个重要不确定性来源，是私人林地所有者对天气变异性变化的经济反应。

title: Wildfires and climate change have lowered the economic value of western US forests by altering risk expectations
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: There is a lack of evidence regarding how natural resource markets have responded to recent increases in climate-induced extreme events like wildfire. Wildfire can affect the economic value of forests by directly damaging the existing tree stock and by altering landowner risk expectations of future wildfire arrival. This paper uses parcel data over a seventeen-year period to estimate the effects of large wildfires and drought stress on market prices for private timberland across the three Pacific states of the western U.S. In addition to estimating the land price impacts of wildfires on parcels that were directly burned, we identify changes in risk expectations by estimating the impacts from wildfires that burned in close proximity rather than directly on timberland that was sold in the land market. Results indicate that recent increases in large wildfires and drought stress over the past two decades have lowered the economic value of timberland by approximately 10%, or about $11.2 billion in damages across the three Pacific states, with approximately 5.5% (∼$6.2 billion) due to climate change. Most of the wildfire damages arise from changes in risk expectations. Results provide evidence on the costs of climate-induced extreme events on natural capital that have already occurred.
abstract_zh: 关于自然资源市场如何应对近期由野火等气候引发的极端事件增加，目前证据不足。野火既会直接破坏现有林木存量，也会改变土地所有者对未来野火发生的风险预期，从而影响森林的经济价值。本文利用十七年期间的地块数据，估计了大型野火和干旱胁迫对美国西部三个太平洋沿岸州私有林地市场价格的影响。除估计直接烧毁地块的地价影响外，我们还通过估计在靠近但并非直接烧毁已售林地的地方发生的野火的影响，来识别风险预期的变化。结果表明，在过去二十年间，大型野火和干旱胁迫的增加，使林地经济价值降低了约10%，即三个太平洋沿岸州约112亿美元的损失，其中约5.5%（约62亿美元）归因于气候变化。大部分野火损失源于风险预期的变化。研究结果为已经发生的极端气候事件对自然资本造成的成本提供了证据。

title: An empirical analysis of U.S. land-use change under multiple climate change scenarios
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association

title: A major shift in U.S. land development avoids significant losses in forest and agricultural land
abstract: Land development, which typically results from the conversion of lands previously in agricultural and forest uses, is one of the most fundamental ways in which humans impact the natural environment. We study the remarkable decline in land development rates across the conterminous United States over the period 2000–2015, which occurred after development rates had grown rapidly over the last two decades of the 20th century. Despite relatively constant population growth since 1980, we find that the current annual rate of land development has declined consistently across several stratifications of the U.S. land base and amounts to less than 25% of the peak rate observed in the mid-late 1990s, implying that the developed land base of the U.S. has become increasingly dense in recent years. We show that the widespread shift in land development rates resulted in 7 million acres of avoided land development, roughly half of which would have come from conversions of forested lands. Panel data econometric estimation indicates that growth in development over the last two decades of the 20th century was driven by falling gas prices (an important component of commuting costs) and, to a lesser extent, rising incomes. Since 2000, however, income growth has been stagnant while gas prices have risen sharply, and we find that the latter has played a larger role in shaping the recent shift towards denser development. Results illustrate an often overlooked effect of how rising gas prices can indirectly avoid losses in forest and agricultural land by reducing developed land-use change.
abstract_zh: 土地开发通常源于原有农业和林业用地的转用，是人类影响自然环境的最根本方式之一。我们研究了2000至2015年美国本土土地开发率的显著下降，这一下降发生在20世纪最后二十年开发率快速增长之后。尽管自1980年以来人口保持相对稳定的增长，我们发现当前的年度土地开发率在美国土地的多个分层中持续下降，且仅为1990年代中后期峰值开发率的不到25%，这意味着美国的开发用地近年来变得日益密集。我们表明，土地开发率的这一广泛转变避免了700万英亩的土地开发，其中约一半原本会来自林地的转用。面板数据计量估计表明，20世纪最后二十年的开发增长主要由汽油价格下跌（通勤成本的重要组成部分）所驱动，收入增长的作用则较小。然而，2000年以来收入增长停滞，而汽油价格大幅上涨，我们发现后者在塑造近期向更高密度开发转变中发挥了更大作用。结果表明，汽油价格上涨通过减少开发用地的变化，间接避免了林地和农地的损失，这是一个常被忽视的效应。

title: Estimating the value of threatened species abundance dynamics
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Estimating welfare impacts of climate change using discrete-choice models of land management: An application to western U.S. forestry
abstract: This study develops a method to estimate the welfare impacts of climate change on landowners using a discrete-choice econometric model of land management. We apply the method to forest management in the Pacific states of the U.S. and estimate welfare effects on the region that holds the largest current commercial value – western Oregon and Washington. We find evidence that a warmer and drier climate will induce an approximate 39 % loss in the economic value of timberland by 2050, though there is heterogeneity across space. The discrete-choice approach allows us to determine that the welfare losses are primarily driven by estimated losses to Douglas-fir, the most commercially valuable species. An alternative approach to welfare analysis from climate change is the Ricardian method, which gives conceptually similar estimates to the discrete-choice method. While we find similar empirical findings between the discrete-choice and Ricardian approaches, the discrete-choice approach provides more heterogeneity and somewhat larger negative welfare impacts. Our analysis is notable for providing the first empirical evidence that climate change can induce welfare losses to timberland owners, even while accounting for optimal adaptation.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种利用土地管理离散选择计量模型，估计气候变化对土地所有者福利影响的方法。我们将该方法应用于美国太平洋各州的森林经营，并估计了对当前商业价值最大的地区——俄勒冈州西部和华盛顿州西部——的福利效应。我们发现，更温暖、更干燥的气候将导致到2050年林地经济价值损失约39%，不过不同空间存在异质性。离散选择方法使我们能够确定，福利损失主要由花旗松（Douglas-fir）的估计损失所驱动，该树种是商业价值最高的树种。气候变化福利分析的另一种方法是李嘉图（Ricardian）方法，它得出的估计结果在概念上与离散选择方法相近。尽管离散选择与李嘉图方法的实证结果相似，但离散选择方法提供了更多的异质性信息，且负面福利影响略大。我们的分析的显著之处在于，它首次提供了实证证据，表明即使考虑了最优适应，气候变化仍会导致林地所有者的福利损失。

title: The effect of carbon fertilization on naturally regenerated and planted US forests
abstract: Over the last half century in the United States, the per-hectare volume of wood in trees has increased, but it is not clear whether this increase has been driven by forest management, forest recovery from past land uses, such as agriculture, or other environmental factors such as elevated carbon dioxide, nitrogen deposition, or climate change. This paper uses empirical analysis to estimate the effect of elevated carbon dioxide on aboveground wood volume in temperate forests of the United States. To accomplish this, we employ matching techniques that allow us to disentangle the effects of elevated carbon dioxide from other environmental factors affecting wood volume and to estimate the effects separately for planted and natural stands. We show that elevated carbon dioxide has had a strong and consistently positive effect on wood volume while other environmental factors yielded a mix of both positive and negative effects. This study, by enabling a better understanding of how elevated carbon dioxide and other anthropogenic factors are influencing forest stocks, can help policymakers and other stakeholders better account for the role of forests in Nationally Determined Contributions and global mitigation pathways to achieve a 1.5 degree Celsius target.
abstract_zh: 在过去的半个世纪里，美国每公顷树木的木材蓄积量有所增加，但尚不清楚这一增长是由森林经营、森林从以往农业等土地利用中恢复，还是由二氧化碳浓度升高、氮沉降或气候变化等其他环境因素所驱动的。本文采用实证分析，估计二氧化碳浓度升高对美国温带森林地上木材蓄积量的影响。为此，我们采用匹配技术，将二氧化碳浓度升高的影响与影响木材蓄积量的其他环境因素区分开来，并分别估计人工林和天然林的效应。我们表明，二氧化碳浓度升高对木材蓄积量具有持续、显著的正向作用，而其他环境因素的影响则有正有负。本研究有助于更好地理解二氧化碳浓度升高及其他人为因素如何影响森林蓄积量，从而帮助政策制定者和其他利益相关方在国家自主贡献以及实现1.5摄氏度温控目标的全球减缓路径中，更好地考虑森林的作用。

title: Amenities and skill sorting: A case study of land conservation policy
Climate, adaptation, and the value of forestland: A national Ricardian analysis of the United States
abstract: This study estimates an econometric Ricardian model of the effects of climate on forestry using a novel national data set of county-level net economic returns to forestland. Results show that climate change projections to 2050 will increase forest net returns on the middle latitudes of eastern U.S. timberland. We quantify the value of extensive margin adaptation to climate change by separately estimating climate's effect on 11 distinct forest types. We find that approximately 69% of the positive climate change effect on eastern U.S. forestry arises from the value of extensive margin adaptation. Climate change impacts in the western United States are inconclusive.(JEL Q23, Q51)
abstract_zh: 本研究利用一套新颖的全国性县级林地净经济回报数据集，估计了气候对林业影响的计量经济学李嘉图模型。结果表明，到2050年的气候变化预测将提高美国东部中纬度林地的净回报。我们通过分别估计气候对11种不同林型的影响，量化了对气候变化进行扩展边际适应的价值。我们发现，美国东部林业所受到的正向气候变化效应中，约69%源于扩展边际适应的价值。美国西部的气候变化影响尚无定论。（JEL Q23, Q51）

title: Negative traffic externalities and infant health: The role of income heterogeneity and residential sorting
Anticipating changes in wildlife habitat induced by private forest owners' adaptation to climate change and carbon policy
Estimating Option Values and Spillover Damages for Coastal Protection: Evidence from Oregon's Planning Goal 18
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: The Intersection between Climate Adaptation, Mitigation, and Natural Resources: An Empirical Analysis of Forest Management
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Forest landowners can adapt to climate change and carbon pricing by altering the types of forests that are replanted or regenerated. By inducing land-use changes within forestry, climate adaptation and mitigation policy can alter the flow of nonmarket forest ecosystem services. The purpose of this paper is to quantify the effect of climate change and carbon pricing on adaptation behavior of private forest owners. We develop an empirical framework with application to the US Pacific coast. An estimated discrete-choice econometric model is used as the empirical basis for a simulation of land-use changes to the composition of a landscape’s forest stock. Results indicate that climate change induces landowners to adapt away from their current dominant species choice of Douglas-fir to species more suitable for the future climate, notably hardwoods and ponderosa pine. A carbon price policy accelerates adaptation away from current forest types, potentially creating an externality at the local level.
abstract_zh: 森林土地所有者可以通过改变重新种植或更新再生的森林类型来适应气候变化和碳定价。通过诱导林业内部的土地利用变化，气候适应与减缓政策可以改变非市场性森林生态系统服务的流量。本文旨在量化气候变化和碳定价对私人林场主适应行为的影响。我们构建了一个实证框架，并将其应用于美国太平洋沿岸地区。我们估计了一个离散选择计量经济模型，并以此为实证基础，模拟景观森林存量构成的土地利用变化。结果表明，气候变化促使土地所有者从当前占主导地位的花旗松树种转向更适应未来气候的树种，特别是阔叶树和西黄松。碳价政策加速了远离当前森林类型的适应过程，可能在地方层面产生外部性。

title: The Spatial Dynamics of the Economic Impacts of an Aquatic Invasive Species: An Empirical Analysis
The non-market benefits of early and partial gains in managing threatened salmon
An Auction Mechanism for the Optimal Provision of Ecosystem Services under Climate Change
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Does the Conservation of Land Reduce Development? An Econometric-Based Landscape Simulation with Land Market Feedbacks
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: How Does Urbanization Affect Water Withdrawals? Insights from an Econometric-Based Landscape Simulation
abstract: Effects on water resources are an understudied aspect of the environmental consequences of urbanization. We study how urban land development affects water withdrawals on a regional scale to account for market adjustments, human behavioral responses, and government institutions. Fine-scale econometric and simulation methods are used to represent the spatial heterogeneity associated with determinants of water withdrawals. Our analysis reveals a complicated relationship between future water withdrawals and changes in socioeconomic drivers. Despite population growth of approximately 85% and a doubling of income, water withdrawals in two urban areas increase by at most 12% and in another area, decrease slightly. (JEL Q24, Q25)
abstract_zh: 城市化对水资源的影响是环境后果中研究不足的一个方面。我们研究了城市土地开发如何在区域尺度上影响取水量，并同时考虑了市场调整、人类行为反应以及政府制度的作用。我们综合运用精细尺度的计量经济学方法与模拟方法，以刻画与取水量决定因素相关的空间异质性。我们的分析揭示了未来取水量与社会经济驱动因素变化之间的复杂关系。尽管人口增长约85%、收入翻了一番，两个城市地区的取水量最多仅增加12%，而另一地区的取水量则略有下降。（JEL Q24, Q25）

title: Quasi-Experimental Methods Enable Stronger Inferences from Observational Data in Ecology
Conservation Land Amenities and Regional Economies: A Post-Matching Difference-in-Differences Analysis of the Northwest Forest Plan
Estimating the Counterfactual Impact of Conservation Programs on Land Cover Outcomes: The Role of Matching and Panel Regression Techniques
Land-Use Patterns and Spatially Dependent Ecosystem Services: Some Microeconomic Foundations
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: This paper develops and reviews some microeconomic foundations for the provision of spatially-dependent ecosystem services from land. We focus on ecosystem services described by a production function with spatial dependencies in the primary input — the amount and pattern of land in particular uses and management. Many ecosystem service production functions are affected by spatial dependences, particularly those involving fish, wildlife, and water quality. We illustrate the various sources of demand for ecosystem services and then provide a novel development of the effects of alternative spatial dependencies on the shape of the supply curve for ecosystem services. Our analysis emphasizes that the optimal supply curve requires a mechanism to coordinate landowners’ decisions and internalize the input externalities that arise from production functions being spatially dependent. Finally, we use our framework to illustrate and review some key implications for linking demand and supply for policy design.
abstract_zh: 本文发展并综述了土地提供空间依赖性生态系统服务的一些微观经济学基础。我们关注的生态系统服务由一个在主要投入——土地的数量与格局及其特定用途和管理——中存在空间依赖性的生产函数描述。许多生态系统服务生产函数都受到空间依赖性的影响，尤其是涉及鱼类、野生动物和水质的服务。我们阐明了生态系统服务需求的各种来源，随后对不同空间依赖性如何影响生态系统服务供给曲线的形状进行了新颖的推导。我们的分析强调，最优供给曲线需要一种机制来协调土地所有者的决策，并将因生产函数存在空间依赖性而产生的投入外部性内部化。最后，我们运用该框架阐释并综述了将需求与供给联系起来以进行政策设计的若干关键含义。

title: Protected Area Effectiveness in European Russia: A Post-Matching Panel Data Analysis
Scenarios of Future Land Use Change around United States' Protected Areas
Using an Intervention Framework to Value Salient Ecosystem Services in a Stated Preference Experiment
Implementing the Optimal Provision of Ecosystem Services
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Many ecosystem services are public goods whose provision depends on the spatial pattern of land use. The pattern of land use is often determined by the decisions of multiple private landowners. Increasing the provision of ecosystem services, though beneficial for society as a whole, may be costly to private landowners. A regulator interested in providing incentives to landowners for increased provision of ecosystem services often lacks complete information on landowners' costs. The combination of spatially dependent benefits and asymmetric cost information means that the optimal provision of ecosystem services cannot be achieved using standard regulatory or payment for ecosystem services approaches. Here we show that an auction that sets payments between landowners and the regulator for the increased value of ecosystem services with conservation provides incentives for landowners to truthfully reveal cost information, and allows the regulator to implement the optimal provision of ecosystem services, even in the case with spatially dependent benefits and asymmetric information.
abstract_zh: 许多生态系统服务属于公共品，其供给取决于土地利用的空间格局。而土地利用格局通常由多个私人土地所有者的决策共同决定。增加生态系统服务的供给虽然对整个社会有益，但对私人土地所有者而言可能成本高昂。监管者若希望激励土地所有者增加生态系统服务的供给，往往缺乏关于土地所有者成本的完整信息。空间依赖的效益与不对称的成本信息相结合，意味着标准的监管手段或生态系统服务付费方式无法实现生态系统服务的最优供给。本文表明，一种拍卖机制能够激励土地所有者如实揭示成本信息：该机制在土地所有者与监管者之间设定支付额，用以补偿保育所带来的生态系统服务增值，从而使监管者即使在效益存在空间依赖且信息不对称的情形下，也能实现生态系统服务的最优供给。

title: The Economics of Wildlife Conservation
The Effect of Decentralized Governance on Timber Extraction in European Russia
Threats and Opportunities for Freshwater Conservation under Future Land Use Change Scenarios in the United States
abstract: Freshwater ecosystems provide vital resources for humans and support high levels of biodiversity, yet are severely threatened throughout the world. The expansion of human land uses, such as urban and crop cover, typically degrades water quality and reduces freshwater biodiversity, thereby jeopardizing both biodiversity and ecosystem services. Identifying and mitigating future threats to freshwater ecosystems requires forecasting where land use changes are most likely. Our goal was to evaluate the potential consequences of future land use on freshwater ecosystems in the coterminous United States by comparing alternative scenarios of land use change (2001–2051) with current patterns of freshwater biodiversity and water quality risk. Using an econometric model, each of our land use scenarios projected greater changes in watersheds of the eastern half of the country, where freshwater ecosystems already experience higher stress from human activities. Future urban expansion emerged as a major threat in regions with high freshwater biodiversity (e.g., the Southeast) or severe water quality problems (e.g., the Midwest). Our scenarios reflecting environmentally oriented policies had some positive effects. Subsidizing afforestation for carbon sequestration reduced crop cover and increased natural vegetation in areas that are currently stressed by low water quality, while discouraging urban sprawl diminished urban expansion in areas of high biodiversity. On the other hand, we found that increases in crop commodity prices could lead to increased agricultural threats in areas of high freshwater biodiversity. Our analyses illustrate the potential for policy changes and market factors to influence future land use trends in certain regions of the country, with important consequences for freshwater ecosystems. Successful conservation of aquatic biodiversity and ecosystem services in the United States into the future will require attending to the potential threats and opportunities arising from policies and market changes affecting land use.
abstract_zh: 淡水生态系统为人类提供重要资源，并支撑着高水平的生物多样性，但在全球范围内正面临严重威胁。城市和作物覆盖等人类土地利用的扩张，通常会导致水质下降并减少淡水生物多样性，从而危及生物多样性和生态系统服务。要识别并减缓对淡水生态系统的未来威胁，需要预测土地利用变化最可能发生的地点。我们的目标是通过比较不同的土地利用变化情景（2001–2051年）与当前淡水生物多样性和水质风险的格局，评估未来土地利用对美国本土淡水生态系统的潜在后果。利用计量经济学模型，我们每种土地利用情景都预测，在人类活动已对淡水生态系统造成较大压力的美国东半部，流域变化将更大。未来的城市扩张在淡水生物多样性高的地区（例如东南部）或水质问题严重的地区（例如中西部）成为一大威胁。我们侧重环境导向政策的情景产生了一些积极效果。补贴造林以实现碳封存，减少了目前因水质低而承受压力地区的作物覆盖，并增加了自然植被；而遏制城市蔓延则减缓了高生物多样性地区的城市扩张。另一方面，我们发现作物商品价格上涨可能导致高淡水生物多样性地区的农业威胁加剧。我们的分析表明，政策变化和市场因素有可能影响美国某些地区未来的土地利用趋势，并对淡水生态系统产生重要影响。要在未来成功保护美国的水生生物多样性和生态系统服务，就需要关注政策和市场变化对土地利用可能带来的威胁与机遇。

title: Current and Future Land Use around a Nationwide Protected Area Network
abstract: Land-use change around protected areas can reduce their effective size and limit their ability to conserve biodiversity because land-use change alters ecological processes and the ability of organisms to move freely among protected areas. The goal of our analysis was to inform conservation planning efforts for a nationwide network of protected lands by predicting future land use change. We evaluated the relative effect of three economic policy scenarios on land use surrounding the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's National Wildlife Refuges. We predicted changes for three land-use classes (forest/range, crop/pasture, and urban) by 2051. Our results showed an increase in forest/range lands (by 1.9% to 4.7% depending on the scenario), a decrease in crop/pasture between 15.2% and 23.1%, and a substantial increase in urban land use between 28.5% and 57.0%. The magnitude of land-use change differed strongly among different USFWS administrative regions, with the most change in the Upper Midwestern US (approximately 30%), and the Southeastern and Northeastern US (25%), and the rest of the U.S. between 15 and 20%. Among our scenarios, changes in land use were similar, with the exception of our "restricted-urban-growth" scenario, which resulted in noticeably different rates of change. This demonstrates that it will likely be difficult to influence land-use change patterns with national policies and that understanding regional land-use dynamics is critical for effective management and planning of protected lands throughout the U.S.
abstract_zh: 保护区周边的土地利用变化可能减小其有效面积，并限制其保护生物多样性的能力，因为土地利用变化会改变生态过程，并影响生物在保护区之间自由迁移的能力。我们分析的目标是通过预测未来土地利用变化，为全国性保护土地网络的保育规划工作提供信息。我们评估了三种经济政策情景对美国鱼类与野生动物管理局国家野生动物保护区周边土地利用的相对影响。我们预测了到2051年三类土地利用（森林/草场、耕地/牧场和城市）的变化。结果显示，森林/草场面积增加（根据情景不同增加1.9%至4.7%），耕地/牧场面积减少15.2%至23.1%，城市用地则大幅增加28.5%至57.0%。土地利用变化的幅度在美国鱼类与野生动物管理局不同行政区之间差异明显：美国中北部上游地区变化最大（约30%），东南部和东北部为25%，美国其余地区则在15%至20%之间。在我们的各情景中，土地利用变化大体相似，唯一例外是“限制城市增长”情景，其变化速度明显不同。这表明，仅依靠全国性政策可能难以影响土地利用变化格局，而理解区域土地利用动态对于美国保护土地的有效管理和规划至关重要。

title: Key Areas for Conserving United States' Biodiversity Likely Threatened by Future Land Use Change
abstract: A major challenge for biodiversity conservation is to mitigate the effects of future environmental change, such as land use, in important areas for biodiversity conservation. In the United States, recent conservation efforts by The Nature Conservancy and partners have identified and mapped the nation's Areas of Biodiversity Significance (ABS), representing the best remaining habitats for the full diversity of native species and ecosystems, and thus the most important and suitable areas for the conservation of native biodiversity. Our goal was to understand the potential consequences of future land use changes on the nation's ABS, and identify regions where ABS are likely to be threatened due to future land use expansion. For this, we used an econometric‐based model to forecast land use changes between 2001 and 2051 across the conterminous U.S. under alternative scenarios of future land use change. Our model predicted a total of ∼100,000 to 160,000 km2of natural habitats within ABS replaced by urban, crop and pasture expansion depending on the scenario (5% to 8% habitat loss across the conterminous U.S.), with some regions experiencing up to 30% habitat loss. The majority of the most threatened ABS were located in the Eastern half of the country. Results for our different scenarios were generally fairly consistent, but some regions exhibited notable difference from the baseline under specific policies and changes in commodity prices. Overall, our study suggests that key areas for conserving United States' biodiversity are likely threatened by future land use change, and efforts trying to preserve the ecological and conservation values of ABS will need to address the potential intensification of human land uses.
abstract_zh: 保护生物多样性的一项重大挑战，在于减轻未来环境变化（如土地利用变化）对重要生物多样性保育区域的影响。在美国，大自然保护协会（The Nature Conservancy）及其合作伙伴近期识别并绘制了全国的生物多样性重要区域（ABS），这些区域代表了为全部本土物种和生态系统所保留的最佳栖息地，因而是保护本土生物多样性最为重要且最适宜的区域。我们的目标是理解未来土地利用变化对全国ABS可能产生的后果，并识别ABS可能因未来土地扩张而受到威胁的地区。为此，我们使用一个基于计量经济学的模型，预测了2001年至2051年间美国本土在不同未来土地利用变化情景下的土地利用变化。模型预测，根据情景不同，约10万至16万平方公里ABS内的自然栖息地将被城市、作物和牧场扩张所取代（美国本土栖息地损失5%至8%），部分地区的栖息地损失高达30%。受威胁最严重的ABS大多位于美国东半部。各情景的结果总体上相当一致，但在特定政策和商品价格变化下，部分地区与基准情景存在显著差异。总体而言，我们的研究表明，美国生物多样性的关键保育区域很可能受到未来土地利用变化的威胁，因此，要保护ABS的生态与保育价值，就需要应对人类土地利用可能加剧的问题。

abstract: This paper examines spatial spillovers associated with the adoption of organic dairy farming. We hypothesize that neighboring farmers can help to reduce the uncertainty of organic conversion by lowering the fixed costs of learning about the organic system. A spatially explicit 10-year panel dataset of more than 1,900 dairy farms in southwestern Wisconsin is used as input into a reduced-form econometric model of the decision to convert to organic production. Using an identification strategy that exploits the panel aspect of the micro dataset, we find evidence that the presence of neighboring organic dairy farms affects the conversion decision. (JEL Q15, Q24)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了有机乳业养殖采用过程中的空间溢出效应。我们假设，邻近的农场主可以通过降低了解有机生产体系的固定学习成本，帮助减少有机转换的不确定性。我们使用西南威斯康星州一千九百多个乳制品农场的空间明确的十年期面板数据集，构建了关于有机生产转换决策的简化式计量经济模型。利用微观数据的面板特征进行识别，我们发现，邻近有机乳制品农场的存在会影响转换决策。（JEL Q15, Q24）

title: The Effects of Aquatic Invasive Species on Property Values: Evidence from a Quasi Experiment
Efficiency of Incentives to Jointly Increase Carbon Sequestration and Species Conservation on a Landscape
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: We develop an integrated model to predict private land-use decisions in response to policy incentives designed to increase the provision of carbon sequestration and species conservation across heterogeneous landscapes. Using data from the Willamette Basin, Oregon, we compare the provision of carbon sequestration and species conservation under five simple policies that offer payments for conservation. We evaluate policy performance compared with the maximum feasible combinations of carbon sequestration and species conservation on the landscape for various conservation budgets. None of the conservation payment policies produce increases in carbon sequestration and species conservation that approach the maximum potential gains on the landscape. Our results show that policies aimed at increasing the provision of carbon sequestration do not necessarily increase species conservation and that highly targeted policies do not necessarily do as well as more general policies.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个综合模型，用以预测私人土地利用决策对政策激励的反应，这些激励旨在增加异质性景观中的碳封存和物种保育供给。以俄勒冈州威拉米特流域的数据为例，我们比较了五种提供保育支付的简单政策下的碳封存和物种保育供给。我们以不同保育预算水平下景观上可实现的碳封存与物种保育最大组合为基准，评估各政策的绩效。结果表明，没有任何一种保育支付政策能够使碳封存和物种保育的增幅接近景观上的最大潜在增益。我们的结果显示，旨在增加碳封存供给的政策不一定会增加物种保育，而高度定向的政策也不一定比更为普遍的政策效果更好。

Public Conservation Land and Employment Growth in the Northern Forest Region
abstract: We quantify the effect that public conservation lands have on employment growth in the Northern Forest region of the United States. A model of simultaneous employment and net migration growth is estimated with data on non-metropolitan counties from 1990 to 1997. Exogenous variables include the 1990 share of the land base in public conservation uses. We find that net migration rates were higher in counties with more conservation lands, but the effects are relatively small. No significant effect on employment growth is detected. As well, variables measuring changes in public timber harvests have no effect on employment growth. (JEL Q26)
abstract_zh: 我们量化了公共保育用地对美国北部森林地区就业增长的影响。利用1990年至1997年非大都市县的数据，我们估计了就业增长与净迁移增长的联立模型。外生变量包括1990年公共保育用途土地在土地基础中所占的份额。我们发现，保育用地较多的县，净迁移率更高，但效应相对较小。我们未发现对就业增长有显著影响。同样，衡量公共木材采伐量变化的变量对就业增长也没有影响。（JEL Q26）

title: Easements and Conservation Policy in the North Maine Woods
abstract: Recently Maine has embarked on a new policy direction in its use of conservation easements to protect large tracts of commercial timberland. David Lewis argues that the effectiveness of using easements as a long-term conservation policy depends on many factors that may not be fully considered in the decision-making process currently used in choosing easements for landscape-scale conservation. Lewis indicates that the root of the problem lies in the fact that the state lacks a comprehensive policy describing the conservation goals desired in the North Woods. Before progressing further, Lewis suggests that the ultimate goals of conservation need to be understood clearly. Is conservation addressing development? Recreation needs? Biodiversity protection? Forest fragmentation? Moreover, what are the costs and benefits associated with the state’s various conservation options?
abstract_zh: 近来，缅因州在利用保护地役权保护大面积商品林地方面，采取了新的政策方向。大卫·刘易斯（David Lewis）认为，将地役权作为长期保护政策的有效性，取决于许多因素，而这些因素在当前用于选择景观尺度保护地役权的决策过程中可能并未得到充分考虑。刘易斯指出，问题的根源在于该州缺乏一项全面的政策，来描述北部林区期望实现的保护目标。他建议，在进一步推进之前，必须清晰地理解保护的最终目标。保护是为了应对开发？满足休闲需求？保护生物多样性？还是防止森林破碎化？此外，该州各项保护选择的成本与收益分别是什么？
